title: DerivativeConvolutionalPerceptron.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Strict feasibility of bilinear inequalities m_i(a,b,w)=a⟨D_i,w⟩+b⟨shift(D_i),w⟩>0 in jointly variable (a,b,w). No optimization objective is specified.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A chosen sample index and arbitrary parameter vector return that sample's exact bilinear-margin gradient. Replies are identical for every history and oracle seed; there is no noise or sampling restriction.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: Each call also returns the exact margin of the queried sample at the queried parameter vector.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Features lie in Euclidean R^d, d>0; parameters lie in R²×R^d. There are samples+1 hidden feature vectors.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public parameters are d,n,g=lower,R=upper,μ=contrast,κ=derivativeMargin, with 0<g≤R, μ>0, 0<κ≤1 and μ/R≤κ^20(g/R)^24/2^400. Hidden samples satisfy D_i=(β_i/√2)axis+μz_i, g≤|β_i|≤R, ⟨axis,z_i⟩=0, ‖z_i‖≤1/2. A hidden unit separator s satisfies ⟨(z_i−shift(z_i))/√2,s⟩≥κ for every i. No initialization or algorithm-family restriction is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DerivativeConvolutionalPerceptron.lean: Geometry, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Setup.allowedAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The single output must have strictly positive bilinear margin on every sample. There is no epsilon tolerance or prescribed positive output margin.

accuracy.label: deterministic
accuracy.details: Success is required for every combined algorithm and oracle seed, including seeds of probability zero; the guarantee is pointwise rather than merely almost sure.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The formulation combines bilinear convolutional separation with a specific constant-background decomposition, derivative-feature margin, and extreme contrast restriction, under an unrestricted exact sample oracle.

descriptionHtml:
Derivative Convolutional Perceptron Separation

We seek to separate samples b0,…,bn∈Rd, where d≥1 and n≥0 are integers, using parameters θ=((a1,a2),w)∈R2×Rd. With S denoting the cyclic coordinate shift, the margin is mi(θ)=a1⟨bi,w⟩+a2⟨Sbi,w⟩. Each sample comprises a bounded, nonzero constant background and a small centered defect; the normalized cyclic differences of the defects share a unit separator with positive margin. The defect scale satisfies a quantitative smallness condition relative to the background bounds and derivative margin. The oracle returns mi(θ) and its parameter derivative at a queried pair (i,θ). The goal is an output θ¯ with mi(θ¯)>0 for every sample and every realization of algorithm randomness.

Equip the feature space Rd with its Euclidean inner product and norm. Index coordinates by j=0,…,d−1, and write (Sv)j=v(j−1)modd,u=1d(1,…,1). The task is strict feasibility of all sample margins in the parameter space R2×Rd. The algorithm receives d,n,g,R,μ,κ, where 0<g≤R,μ>0,0<κ≤1; the samples and their geometric witnesses are accessible only through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Background and derivative separation). There exist scalars c0,…,cn∈R, defects v0,…,vn∈Rd, and a common separator s∈Rd such that ∥s∥=1 and, for every i=0,…,n, bi=ci2u+μvi, g≤|ci|≤R, ⟨u,vi⟩=0,∥vi∥≤12, ⟨vi−Svi2,s⟩≥κ.

Assumption 2 (Contrast scale). The contrast and background scales satisfy μR≤κ202400(gR)24.

At any query (i,θ)∈{0,…,n}×(R2×Rd), the oracle returns the exact scalar margin and derivative direction mi(θ)=a1⟨bi,w⟩+a2⟨Sbi,w⟩, hi(θ)=((⟨bi,w⟩,⟨Sbi,w⟩),a1bi+a2Sbi). Here hi(θ) represents the parameter derivative under the Euclidean coordinate pairing. Initialization is chosen by the algorithm. After the allotted oracle calls, its output θ¯∈R2×Rd must satisfy mi(θ¯)>0for every i=0,…,n, for every realization of its randomness.

source:
import LongTails.Setups.ManySampleConvolutionalPerceptron

open OracleTemplate
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.DerivativeConvolutionalPerceptron

abbrev Features := TwoSampleQuadraticPerceptron.Features
abbrev Space := ManySampleConvolutionalPerceptron.Space
abbrev Reply := ManySampleConvolutionalPerceptron.Reply
noncomputable abbrev axis := ManySampleConvolutionalPerceptron.axis
abbrev Data (d n : ℕ) := Fin (n + 1) → Features d
abbrev Query (d n : ℕ) := Fin (n + 1) × Space d

structure Geometry {d n : ℕ} (D : Data d n) (g R μ κ : ℝ) where
  background : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ
  defect : Fin (n + 1) → Features d
  separator : Features d
  sample_eq : ∀ i, D i = (background i / Real.sqrt 2) • axis d + μ • defect i
  background_lower : ∀ i, g ≤ |background i|
  background_upper : ∀ i, |background i| ≤ R
  centered : ∀ i, ⟪axis d, defect i⟫ = 0
  defect_norm : ∀ i, ‖defect i‖ ≤ 1 / 2
  separator_norm : ‖separator‖ = 1
  derivative_margin : ∀ i, κ ≤ ⟪(Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ •
    (defect i - TwoSampleQuadraticPerceptron.shift (defect i)), separator⟫

noncomputable def answer {d n : ℕ} (D : Data d n) (query : Query d n) : Reply d :=
  ⟨TwoSampleQuadraticPerceptron.margin .conv d (D query.1) query.2,
    TwoSampleQuadraticPerceptron.direction .conv d (D query.1) query.2⟩

def Separates {d n : ℕ} (D : Data d n) (θ : Space d) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, 0 < TwoSampleQuadraticPerceptron.margin .conv d (D i) θ

structure Params where
  dimension : ℕ
  samples : ℕ
  lower : ℝ
  upper : ℝ
  contrast : ℝ
  derivativeMargin : ℝ

noncomputable def spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := Data p.dimension p.samples
  Query p := Query p.dimension p.samples
  Reply p := Reply p.dimension
  Output p := Space p.dimension
  publicInput := id
  valid p :=
    0 < p.dimension ∧ 0 < p.lower ∧ p.lower ≤ p.upper ∧ 0 < p.contrast ∧
      0 < p.derivativeMargin ∧ p.derivativeMargin ≤ 1 ∧
      p.contrast / p.upper ≤ p.derivativeMargin ^ 20 * (p.lower / p.upper) ^ 24 / 2 ^ 400
  admissible p D oracle :=
    Nonempty (Geometry D p.lower p.upper p.contrast p.derivativeMargin) ∧
    ∀ history query seed, oracle.answer history query seed = answer D query.2
  successful _ D output _ := ∀ ω, Separates D (output ω)

end LongTails.Setups.DerivativeConvolutionalPerceptron
